item.title: Medline Industries, LP: Medline Basic Homecare Beds and Medlite Homecare Beds and Accessories MDR107000P BED, MANUAL, MEDLITE Recall
item.product: Medline Basic Homecare Beds and Medlite Homecare Beds and Accessories MDR107000P BED, MANUAL, MEDLITE
item.summary: Potential fire hazard involving the hand control pendant and associated wiring used with affected beds. Pendant or pendant wiring may overheat, potentially leading to smoking, sparking, melting, burning, or fire. Additional products added to 11/26/2025 recall. Product details: Medline Basic Homecare Beds and Medlite Homecare Beds and Accessories MDR107000P BED, MANUAL, MEDLITE
item.affectedPeople: Distribution US Nationwide including territories of Puerto Rico and Guam and the countries of Bermuda, Canada, and Panama.
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
